title: Linear graph area formula and positivity of the graph Gram determinant
statement:
Let n, l be natural numbers, e_a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1 the standard basis of R^n, and P : R^n -> R^l a continuous linear map. Put g(P) := I_n + (

)_{a,b} (the matrix 1 + Matrix.of (fun a b => inner (P e_a) (P e_b))) and Lambda_P(v) := graphPoint v (P v) = (v, P v). Then det g(P) > 0, and for every set S of R^n (no measurability assumed), H^n(Lambda_P(S)) = sqrt(det g(P)) * L^n(S), where H^n = muHE[n] on R^(n+l) and L^n = volume on R^n (as an identity in [0, infinity], the factor being ENNReal.ofReal of the square root).
